product_name: Marshall Willen II Portable Bluetooth Speaker with 17+ Hours of Portable Playtime, Dust & Waterproof (IP67) - Black & Brass
product_description: The Marshall Willen II is a compact, lightweight portable Bluetooth speaker delivering Marshall Signature Sound with balanced audio and enhanced bass. It offers 17+ hours of playtime, IP67 dust and waterproof protection, a built-in microphone for hands-free calls, Bluetooth LE Audio support, and a rubber fastening strap for attaching the speaker almost anywhere.
about_this_item: Marshall signature sound: Willen II's slightly larger frame maximises bass, while improved drivers deliver balanced sound across frequencies at any volume.
17+ hours of portable playtime on a single charge.
Dust and waterproof with an IP67 rating, allowing the speaker to be submerged in up to 1 metre of water for up to 30 minutes.
Fastening strap lets you stand it up, lay it down, attach it to an object, or hang it almost anywhere.
Built-in microphone allows completely hands-free phone calls.
Bluetooth LE Audio-ready for the latest connectivity possibilities.

audio.drivers: One 2-inch 10W full-range driver + two passive radiators

connectivity.bluetooth_range: Up to 100 m in free field

battery.quick_charge: 20 minutes of charging provides 5.5 hours of playtime
